notes.text: Colton Parayko is day to day (upper body injury) and missed their last game. Brandon Carlo has taken his spot beside Philip Broberg.

Logan Mailloux is out long term and has not played this season. He is a top-four defenseman. Adam Jiříček has taken his spot beside Philip Broberg. That pair has had 65% of the chances at 5-on-5 in 80:05 together.
Aleksanteri Kaskimäki was added to the roster on Oct 18 and has played beside Pius Suter and Otto Stenberg.

Scott Morrow has not played this season.

Sean Durzi has started killing penalties: on the ice for 32% of the team’s shorthanded time in 14 games, up from 7% with his old team last season.

story.head: Who’s in net for the Rangers?
paras: The Rangers are on a three-game losing streak, while the Blues have won two in a row. Going in, the Blues are fifth in the Central (tied for 19th in the NHL) and the Rangers fifth in the Metropolitan (tied for 19th).

The Blues have played better than their record (.536) says: their chances are worth about .593, and their goaltending has held them back. The Rangers’ record (.536) is about what their chances are worth.

The Blues keep dangerous shots away better than anyone (1st) and keep things calm after the whistle (lowest), but have struggled on the power play (32nd). On the other side, the Rangers lean on their stars as much as almost anyone (2nd lowest), forecheck as hard as almost anyone (2nd) and get a lot of their shots blocked (32nd). The Blues’ good looks will be harder to come by against the Rangers. Beyond that, both teams play slow, low-event hockey, so expect a tight one.

Dylan Holloway (3 G / 9 A / 12 P in 14 GP) leads the Blues in scoring, and Jimmy Snuggerud (8 G / 3 A / 11 P in 14 GP) has a team-high eight goals. For the Rangers, Adam Fox (1 G / 16 A / 17 P in 14 GP) leads the way in scoring, with eight points in his last five games. Alexis Lafrenière (9 G / 7 A / 16 P in 14 GP) has a team-high nine goals.
Joel Hofer (6-3-1 / .917 SV% in 10 GS) has been terrific for St. Louis and will likely start. Dylan Garand (4-5-1 / .899 SV% in 8 GS) is in line to start for the Rangers.

Jimmy Snuggerud has seven goals on chances worth about 3.0 goals, well above what his finishing usually turns chances into. Runs like that tend to cool off.
Pius Suter is two goals from 100.
